codeReview.summary: The worker successfully fixed an unrequested YAML parser issue in validate-agents.mjs that was blocking validation, but failed to implement the requested fix for Auto-regenerated JSON determinism.

issues.description: Worker did not fix the generator scripts to be deterministic. Running 'pnpm index-rules' leaves numerous files dirty in git status because the generated files use inconsistent key ordering or formatting. The worker bypassed this requirement by manually running prettier instead of fixing the underlying generator scripts.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker bypassed a determinism requirement by manually running prettier on auto-generated files to pass format/validation checks, instead of modifying the generator script to produce deterministic output as explicitly requested.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows: 'pnpm exec prettier --write .claude/config/skill-index.json .claude/context/config/rule-index.json'. A subsequent run of 'pnpm index-rules' leaves >100 files dirty.

summary: Worker failed to implement the Auto-regenerated JSON determinism requirement. While the worker correctly fixed a blocking YAML parser issue and identified that other path/glob issues were already resolved in the codebase, they took an unacceptable shortcut by manually formatting generated files instead of making the generator scripts deterministic.
